usage.finalMessage:
The `member` command now shows the loan period after the member's standing. The loan period is defined once, per member type, in `Policy.loanPeriodDays`, and both borrowing and the member view use it. All 17 tests pass, and the work and `.work/report.json` are committed.
I did not apply DEC-009 (28-day student loans), even though the handoff note asks for it: it is only proposed and has not been reviewed, so every member type stays at 21 days. I also updated the old L01 test to the new `member` output, since L13 changes that format.
Open question in the report: whether the Head of Lending will accept DEC-009. Turning it on would then be a one-line change in `Policy.fs`.

OUTCOME: completed
